pr_title: Create a GDScript String function repeat
pr_body:
Create and expose `String.repeat` to GDScript.
Fixes #30610
pr_comments: @akien-mga @Calinou Let me know if this would be useful. Created as per suggestion in #30610.
I assume its only `doc\classes\String.xml` for documentations changes.
Can be made more optimal by using a StringBuilder, or by at least reserving all the space upfront.

issue_context.title: No string multiplication
issue_context.body:
In various projects I've worked on, I've found python-style string multiplication to be a useful thing that was lacking in gdscript.
ex: `"hello" * 5` would evaluate to `"hellohellohellohellohello"`
comments:
```
for i in range(5):
    string += string
```
What about adding a `String.repeat()` method for this? This way, you could use `"hello".repeat(5)`.

In autoload "Global":
```
func repeat_string(_str:String, count:int) -> String:
    var str:String = ""
    for i in range(count):
        str += _str
    return str
```

In any script file in the project:
```
print(Global.repeat_string("string", 5))
```

In console:
```
stringstringstringstringstring
```
